prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1171; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in League City, Texas, and was turning left when the vehicle was struck by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through on the same roadway. Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy involved. Upon arrival, the responding officer confirmed Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel, and a Passenger was also present in the vehicle, as both occupants were identified at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee, which the officer noted is consistent with the direction and force of the impact to the driver side of the vehicle. Driver 2 acknowledged the collision occurred as Driver 1 described it. Two witnesses on the sidewalk gave statements that matched this account, and photographs taken at the scene show damage concentrated on the front driver side and the corresponding area of the other vehicle. The damage appears largely in line with the reported impact. No prior damage to the vehicle was known to any party or observed by the officer. Traffic control was not active at the time, and no citations were issued at the scene.
